pages.title: Axiom Lamp
pages.text: A lamp that shines when its axiom is in force. Its light is steady and colourless, and when the axiom is withdrawn it simply goes dark. Rows of them read like a truth table drawn in light. Watching them, I finally understood how much of mathematics is a matter of choice.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)These lit and darkened as I flipped axiom toggles inside the proof. They showed me which postulates I had accepted, and which I had not.
